title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Job Overview We are looking for a SeniorSDET to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow.This role is focused on theexecution of pre-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour. The ideal candidate has strong distributed-systems and API-testing experience andmaintainsdisciplined technical evidence capture and traceability. This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre-approved benign scenarios. 
 Project Details 
 
 Title: Senior SDET 
 Rate: $13.5/hr 
 Start Date: 19th October 
 Duration: 5 Weeks 
 Commitment : 33 Hours per Week 
 Location: India (Remote) 
 Job Type: Freelance 

 Responsibilities Analyzedistributed system APIs tovalidatecorrectness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record-linking Execute pre-approved request variations and boundary-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints. Investigate systembehaviorunder malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data-handling requirements. Validatebehaviorof near-real-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer-running background verification/risk pipelines(evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer ofdefensebehaves as expected Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed APIbehavior. Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET. Document observable account/CID lifecyclebehaviorand downstream state changes for handoff Capture and archive test logs andevidencein a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post-incident reviews Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, andvalidatefixes for distributed-system defects Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure-mode and chaos-style testing Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams. 
 Required Qualifications Strong experienceof 5-8+ years intesting distributed systems andanalyzinginter-service APIbehavior Hands-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques Understanding of layereddefensearchitectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases Strong analytical and investigative skills for root-causing complex, systemic defects Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred. Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred. Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence-based reporting requirements is a plus

title: Software Engineering Manager - Enterprise Portfolio Systems
description:
Short Description 
 We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the delivery, modernization, and operational excellence of a critical enterprise portfolio spanning Planisware, Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), and EWHMS applications built on the Microsoft .NET platform. This leader will balance hands-on engineering (40-60% of time) with people leadership, helping establish a high-performing engineering culture while driving architecture, modernization, platform reliability, DevSecOps practices, and AI-enabled engineering improvements. 
 Description 
 The Engineering Manager will be accountable for technical leadership, solution architecture, engineering quality, operational excellence, and team development across a portfolio of enterprise planning, budgeting, project management, and workforce management solutions. The role requires deep experience in enterprise software delivery, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) platforms, cloud integrations, Microsoft .NET technologies, and modern engineering practices. The successful candidate will lead engineers while remaining actively involved in technical design, production support, code reviews, performance optimization, incident management, and platform industrialization. 
 Responsibilities 
 Technical Leadership & Solution Design Maintain 40-60% hands-on involvement in architecture, design reviews, troubleshooting, and engineering decisions. Lead technical delivery across Planisware, Oracle EPM, and EWHMS platforms. Define solution architecture for integrations, APIs, databases, services, security, and cloud components. Establish engineering standards and reusable architecture patterns. Drive design reviews, technical governance, and production readiness assessments. Lead resolution of complex performance, integration, and data integrity issues. Evaluate technology decisions using a "configure, extend, integrate, or build" framework. 
 Platform Engineering & Industrialization 
 Drive lifecycle management for Planisware and Oracle EPM platforms, including upgrades, release planning, patching, and vendor engagement. Establish standards for configuration management, source control, testing, deployment, and rollback. Reduce operational complexity through automation and reusable tooling. Ensure platforms remain scalable, supportable, secure, and upgradeable. 
 DevSecOps & Operations 
 Lead CI/CD implementation and engineering automation practices. Establish automated testing strategies across applications and integrations. Ensure compliance with security, audit, access control, and vulnerability management requirements. Own production readiness, monitoring, incident response, recovery procedures, and operational metrics. Drive measurable improvements in platform availability, reliability, MTTR, and change success rates. 
 Product Delivery & Stakeholder Partnership 
 Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Security, Operations, and business stakeholders. Translate business priorities into delivery roadmaps and technical execution plans. Manage dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and technical debt. Ensure engineering investments support measurable customer and business outcomes. 
 People Leadership 
 Build, coach, and develop a high-performing engineering team. Conduct regular performance and career-development discussions. Create individual growth plans and succession strategies. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and psychological safety. Promote best practices through mentoring, architecture reviews, technical forums, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. 
 AI-Enabled Engineering 
 Drive adoption of approved AI-assisted engineering tools. Use AI to improve productivity through automation, testing, documentation, analysis, and operational support. Promote responsible AI usage while protecting confidential and sensitive enterprise data. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. Significant experience in software engineering and enterprise application delivery. Experience leading software engineering teams in complex enterprise environments. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft .NET technologies including C#, APIs, and SQL databases. Experience designing and supporting enterprise integrations. Experience implementing DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and production support practices. Strong architecture, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience managing vendors and third-party software platforms. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Planisware administration, configuration, scripting, integrations, and platform upgrades. Experience with Oracle EPM including planning, budgeting, forecasting, metadata management, and integrations. Experience with Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS). Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience supporting enterprise financial planning and portfolio management systems. Experience implementing AI-assisted engineering practices. Experience working within Agile and SAFe delivery frameworks.

description:
Senior Automation Engineer - Playwright & TypeScript | Browser Automation 
 Location: Remote (India)
 Experience: 4 to 9 years
 Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST (aligned to US Eastern business hours) 
 Role Overview 
 We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build production browser automation using Playwright and TypeScript. This is a development role, not a testing role. You'll build bots that run every day against real web applications, such as payer portals and healthcare systems, and that need to be reliable, secure, and easy to maintain. You'll join our automation team and work alongside our UiPath developers, choosing the right tool for each workflow. 
 If you've built Playwright or Puppeteer automation for web scraping or data extraction, or you're an SDET who wants to move from testing into building production automation, we'd like to hear from you. US healthcare experience is a plus but not required; we'll teach you the domain. 
 Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain production browser automation using Playwright (TypeScript/Node.js) for workflows such as eligibility checks, claim status, and data extraction from web portals. Build bots that handle real-world conditions: login and session management, slow or unavailable portals, UI changes, and unexpected data. Implement robust error handling, retry logic, and clear exception reporting so failed items are captured and reprocessed rather than lost. Build supporting components: job scheduling, work queues, logging, monitoring, and alerting for failed runs. Handle credentials and data securely. Use a credential vault, never hardcode secrets, and keep PHI out of logs, screenshots, and traces. Integrate automations with APIs, databases, and internal services, and prefer API or EDI integrations over UI automation where they're available. Write clean, reusable, well-documented code. Use Git, participate in code reviews, and follow team engineering standards. Troubleshoot production failures quickly, and improve the stability of existing bots. Work with the Quality Analyst and business teams to understand workflows and validate bot outputs. 
 Required Skills 4+ years of software development or automation engineering experience. 2+ years of hands-on Playwright experience; Puppeteer experience is also relevant. Strong programming skills in TypeScript or JavaScript (Node.js). Strong understanding of Playwright fundamentals: locators, auto-waiting, browser contexts, session/storage state, network handling, and tracing. Experience building automation that runs in production (bots, scrapers, or data extraction pipelines), not only test suites. Experience with REST APIs, JSON, and working knowledge of SQL. Experience with Git and code reviews. Understanding of secure credential handling and sensitive-data practices in automation. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Clear written and spoken English. 
 Nice to Have US Healthcare experience (RCM, payer portals, EMR/EHR systems; eClinicalWorks is a plus). Familiarity with UiPath or other RPA platforms. Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS). Experience with monitoring and logging tools. Understanding of HIPAA and PHI handling. Exposure to AI/LLM-based automation or Playwright MCP. Selenium or Cypress experience.
